title: 2026 DSO Benchmarking Report | Catalyst Index by Henry Schein One | Henry Schein One
summary: Download the 2026 Catalyst Index — benchmarks for DSOs, DPOs, and multi-location practices. See how the top 10% compare to industry averages.
body_text: See Where Your DSO Stands. The 2026 Catalyst Index Is Here. Download the report See how your organization compares Metric Average Top 10% Appointment lead time (new patient) 23 days 4 days Case acceptance rate 45% 75% Patient retention rate 58% 90% Time to payment (insurance) 19 days 8 days Top performers aren’t just more efficient. They’re more consistent. And that consistency shows up everywhere, from diagnosis to dollars collected. What high-performing DSOs do differently? 1. They standardize clinical decision-making The biggest performance gaps aren’t front desk issues; they’re clinical. Top organizations create consistency in how care is diagnosed, presented, and accepted. That’s why they outperform in case acceptance, clinical mix, and long-term patient value. 2. They reduce complexity instead of adding scale Bigger doesn’t automatically mean better. In fact, larger organizations often struggle with collections at the same level or worse than smaller ones. The difference isn’t effort. It’s integration. Top performers eliminate fragmentation across systems and workflows so revenue moves faster and more predictably. 3. They prioritize schedule reliability over raw volume A full schedule doesn’t guarantee performance. Completed visits do. Despite improvements in no-shows and cancellations, retention is declining because efficiency alone doesn’t build patient relationships. The best operators focus on consistency, follow-through, and clear expectations at every step. What You’ll Get in the Full Report Full benchmark data across DSOs, DPOs, and 8+ location groups Year-over-year trends A practical framework to diagnose breakdowns across the patient journey Clear priorities you can apply across locations to drive more consistent, collectible revenue FAQ What is the average case acceptance rate for dental groups and DSOs? According to our data, top-performing organizations have a case acceptance rate of 75%, which typically reflects more consistent clinical workflows and clearer, more confident patient communication. What do top-performing DSOs do to reduce no-shows and cancellations? Top performers don’t leave attendance management up to individual offices. They build reliability into the operating model. That usually means standardized scheduling and confirmation workflows across locations, centralized visibility into schedule risk, and consistent execution supported by training and adoption tracking. What is a good patient retention rate for a multi-location dental practice? The top 10% multi-location practices have a 90% retention. In practice, “good” looks like having repeatable reappointment and follow-up systems that keep patients consistently coming back across every location. How does appointment lead time affect new patient acquisition? Long lead times create friction. Patients are more likely to delay, look elsewhere, or drop off before the visit happens. Faster access increases the likelihood that patients move forward with care, which helps demand convert into completed appointments. What collection rate should DSOs benchmark against? The report’s benchmark shows a 72% average collection rate for 8+ location practices, with top performers at 97%. Those gaps tend to come from cleaner documentation at the point of care, fewer downstream billing errors, and stronger systems for tracking and collecting payments. title: How to Receive International Payments in Pakistan: Fees, Exchange Rates and PRCs
summary: Learn how to receive international payments in Pakistan, compare fees and exchange rates, understand PRCs, and keep more control over when your USD is converted.
body_text: Freelancers in Pakistan can receive international payments through local bank transfers, digital wallets, global payment platforms, or a USD account. The real cost depends on withdrawal fees, exchange-rate margins, intermediary deductions, conversion timing, and whether the payment is documented with a PRC. How Can You Receive International Payments in Pakistan? Common routes include: A direct payout from a freelance platform to a Pakistani bank account in PKR A payout through a global payment platform, followed by a withdrawal to a local bank An international wire to a foreign-currency account in Pakistan A remittance or wallet payout through a local provider A payment to US account details, where the earnings are received and held in USD before being converted The best route is not always the one with the lowest fee shown on screen. Compare the final amount you receive, the exchange rate, the payment timing, and the documentation provided. The Real Costs of Receiving International Payments Withdrawal fee: The flat or percentage fee displayed by the platform. Exchange-rate margin: The difference between the market rate and the rate used to convert your USD into PKR. Receiving fee: A charge applied by the payment provider before you withdraw the money. Intermediary or bank fee: A deduction by a correspondent bank or the receiving bank. Conversion timing: The cost of being forced to convert immediately instead of choosing when to exchange your USD. Documentation: The practical cost of receiving money without the PRC or records you may later need. Receiving International Payments in USD Versus PKR A PKR payout is converted before it reaches you. This is convenient when you need rupees immediately, but you accept the provider's exchange rate and conversion timing. A USD payout lets you hold your earnings in dollars and choose when to convert them. It can also let you pay for eligible international expenses in USD without converting the balance first. The right option depends on how quickly you need PKR, the final exchange rate, transfer fees, and whether the payment route supports the documentation you need. How Exchange Rates and Fees Affect Your Final Payout The exchange rate alone does not tell you what a payment route is worth. The number that matters is your total take-home: the final PKR that reaches you after the exchange rate, transfer fee, receiving fee, and any other deductions. Two providers can advertise similar exchange rates and still deliver very different amounts. Compare the final PKR received, not just the quoted rate. You can also calculate the effective take-home rate by dividing the final PKR amount by the USD amount sent. Rates and fees can change throughout the day. The comparison below uses publicly displayed figures checked on July 24, 2026. Example: How Much PKR You Receive From $1,000 Rates and fees checked on July 24, 2026: Elevate Pay: At the displayed live rate of 275.33 PKR per USD, $1,000 converts to 275,330.00 PKR. A $2 reward shown in the calculator raises the converted amount to $1,002, bringing the final take-home to 275,880.66 PKR. Wise: Wise displayed an exchange rate of 277.86 PKR per USD with an $8.36 fee taken inside the $1,000 sent. The recipient receives 275,540.07 PKR. Payoneer: A public comparison snapshot showed 267,108.84 PKR received from $1,000 after a $30 fee. Payoneer pricing varies by account and withdrawal route. On this snapshot, Elevate Pay and Wise land within a fraction of a percent of each other: with the $2 reward applied, Elevate Pay delivered 340.59 PKR more; without it, Wise's quote came out 210.07 PKR ahead. Both delivered at least 8,200 PKR more than Payoneer. The honest takeaway is that between the closest providers, the winner on any given day comes down to that day's rates and active rewards. What doesn't change day to day is the rest of the picture: with Elevate Pay you receive ACH payments free, hold your earnings in USD until you choose to convert, see the exact PKR amount before confirming, and can get an electronic PRC on withdrawals to supported banks. These are point-in-time quotes from July 24, 2026, not guaranteed rates. Exchange rates, fees, rewards, and provider pricing change. Always compare the final PKR you will receive before confirming. Why Holding USD Can Matter More Than the Visible Fee When a platform sends money directly to a Pakistani bank in PKR, the conversion happens immediately. You cannot choose the day or hold the earnings in dollars. With a USD account, you can: Convert when you need PKR or when the available rate suits you Keep part of your earnings in USD instead of converting the full amount Use eligible USD spending tools for software, hosting, travel, or business expenses Review the exchange rate, fee, and final PKR amount before confirming a transfer What Is a PRC and Why Does It Matter? A Proceeds Realization Certificate, or PRC, records that foreign earnings were received through recognized banking channels. Freelancers may need it for tax records, income verification, PSEB-related requirements, or other compliance and documentation needs. PRC issuance depends on the receiving bank and the payment route. Before choosing a withdrawal method, confirm whether a PRC is available, which purpose code applies, and how the certificate is requested or delivered. With us, withdrawals to supported banks can include an electronic PRC. Meezan Bank is currently supported. Check our latest guidance before withdrawing because supported banks can change. How Elevate Pay Works for Freelancers in Pakistan Open a US-based USD account and receive payments through ACH. Hold the balance in USD until you decide to convert or spend it. Review the exchange rate, fee, and final PKR amount before confirming a local transfer. Receive an electronic PRC on eligible withdrawals to supported banks. Use your ACH details on platforms that accept payments to US bank accounts. Frequently Asked Questions Can I receive international payments in a Pakistani bank account? Yes. Pakistani banks can receive international payments through local payout arrangements, remittance channels, or international wires. The available currency, fees, exchange rate, and documentation depend on the bank and payment route. Can I receive foreign currency in Pakistan? Eligible foreign-currency accounts can receive supported foreign-currency payments. Confirm the account type, incoming-payment requirements, fees, and documentation with the receiving bank before sending money. Which Pakistani banks accept international payments? Many banks support remittances or incoming international payments, but the available route and required information differ. Ask the bank whether it supports the specific payment type, currency, purpose code, and PRC you need. Can JazzCash or Easypaisa receive international payments? Available international-remittance and payout options depend on the sending provider and current wallet partnerships. Check the wallet and payment provider before initiating the transfer. Do freelancers need a PRC in Pakistan? A PRC is an important record of foreign earnings and may be needed for tax, PSEB, banking, or income-verification purposes. The exact requirement depends on the freelancer's situation. Is it better to receive freelance income in USD or PKR? USD provides more control over conversion timing. PKR is more convenient for immediate local spending. Compare the full cost, live exchange rate, payment timing, and PRC availability. How can I reduce the cost of receiving international payments? Compare the final amount rather than only the visible fee. Check the exchange-rate margin, intermediary deductions, receiving fee, conversion timing, and documentation before choosing a route. Disclaimer: This article is for general information only and is not tax, legal, or financial advice. Confirm PRC, tax, and PSEB requirements with your bank or a qualified adviser.

title: 游戏内报道工具重大更新
summary: 更快、更直观的播放器界面，将报告精准分发给相应的审阅人员
body_text: 分享 新闻 安全与文明 游戏内报道工具重大更新 更快、更直观的播放器界面，将报告准确分发给相应的审阅者 作者 马特·考夫曼，首席安全官 已发布 2026年7月1日 Roblox 拥有 1.32 亿日活跃用户，他们与朋友、家人以及来自世界各地的其他玩家齐聚一堂，共同畅玩。1 我们致力于为每一位 Roblox 玩家和创作者营造一个积极、有趣的环境。虽然绝大多数玩家都了解规则并尊重社区，但正如现实世界一样，并非所有人都遵守规则。 正因如此，我们的 内容审核系统 设有多层防护机制，旨在在玩家看到之前就拦截绝大多数不当内容和行为。此外，我们全天候运作，以检测并清除任何可能突破这些防护层的内容。 当某种新兴趋势、具有冒犯性的新俚语，或是违反《 社区准则 》的新尝试确实突破防线时，玩家的举报能帮助我们获取采取迅速行动所需的元数据和上下文信息，并训练我们的审核系统在未来检测此类问题。 我们正在对玩家举报工具进行重大更新，以便玩家能够更轻松地立即举报或屏蔽任何让他们感到不适或不安全的内容。这些更新包括更简单、更直观的举报流程，以及后台简化的处理流程，使我们能够更轻松地审核举报并提供反馈。 全新、直观的举报流程 随着 Roblox 的发展和新功能的增加，举报流程变得日益复杂。玩家可以举报多种类型的互动行为，从文字和语音聊天违规，到行为不当的玩家甚至整个游戏。普通玩家可能并不清楚具体违反了哪条《社区准则》，而且他们也不应该被迫去了解这些细节。我们希望玩家能够快速且准确地做出举报决定，并尽快回到游戏中。 为了简化玩家的举报流程，我们重新设计了游戏内的举报流程，系统会根据举报类型自动调整问题顺序，跳过无关问题，从而大幅加快举报速度。 举报流程的每一步都融入了摘自《 青少年社区准则指南 》的通俗易懂的语言，该指南是由我们与 青少年委员会 合作设计并经过测试的。采用更简化的举报流程和更易懂的语言，有助于玩家确认违反了哪条规则，并更好地理解我们的整体准则。 通过反馈和建议强化举报机制 仅对举报采取静默处理是不够的。我们深知向举报者反馈处理结果至关重要，因此当举报导致采取行动时，我们会针对每份举报发送通知。 在提交举报后，我们还会根据具体情况，立即向玩家提供有用的建议，以便他们自行采取行动。玩家可能会看到有关如何屏蔽问题内容或玩家的信息、相关求助热线的链接，或是自助资源。这些即时提示有助于玩家在举报被审核期间采取自主行动，防止问题再次发生。 反馈有助于玩家了解系统的运行情况，并鼓励提交高质量的报告，这些报告为我们提供了采取行动所需的数据。如今，我们大约99%的情况下都能及时告知玩家其报告已得到处理。2 幕后运作更高效 在后台，新的举报流程采用了一种称为“灵活决策树”的机制。与以往将每份举报都发送到同一个地方、再由人工进行分类并转交至相应团队审核的方式不同，这一新流程能够动态判断玩家举报的问题类型，并确保举报信息连同最相关的证据立即被分发给最合适的团队。 下一步计划 这些改动对我们处理游戏内举报并尽快向玩家提供反馈大有裨益。第三季度，我们将进一步强化举报反馈机制，新增一个永久收件箱，供玩家查看已提交的举报，并了解所有举报（无论是否已处理）的最新状态。 更完善的举报机制有助于我们随着时间的推移不断改进自动化审核系统，在玩家遇到问题之前就将其揪出。随着举报系统的持续优化，玩家需要提交举报的次数将越来越少，因为我们的系统绝大多数时候都能自动拦截最常见的问题。我们的最终目标是，让这些游戏内举报工具主要用于发现 Roblox 平台上的新问题和异常问题，以便我们的系统能够学习并检测这些问题。 1 基于2026年第一季度的数据 2 基于2026年5月24日至2026年6月20日期间的数据

title: Discover Regal Rexnord's Marine Solutions and Set Sail with Our Latest Marine Innovations
body_text: Discover Regal Rexnord's Marine Solutions and Set Sail with Our Latest Marine Innovations Regal Rexnord harbors innovative marine powertrain solutions at SMM Hamburg 2024 Original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and tier suppliers in the marine sector are having to adapt to changeable conditions. For over a century, Regal Rexnord has supplied innovative, customizable power transmission systems that help fleets move with market currents, powering the voyages of innumerable vessels to the next safe harbor. Visit SMM Hamburg 2024 to discover solutions and discuss operational challenges with experts from Regal Rexnord brands including CENTA™ , Jaure™ , Stromag™ , Svendborg Brakes™ , Twiflex™ , Stearns™ , and Wichita Clutch™ in Hall A3, Stand 310 from 3 - 6 September. Providing single source powertrain support for above and below deck applications, Regal Rexnord is the one knowledgeable partner customers need to ensure reliability and efficiency. Its interoperable clutches, brakes, couplings, shaft systems, controls, and data monitoring platforms are in operation across shipping globally. Whether supporting a container ship, cruise ship, tugboat, dredger, fishing vessel, yacht, or a warship – Regal Rexnord has the product and service flexibility to meet requirements. Tightening maritime emissions regulations are driving the adoption of hybrid propulsion systems, and Stromag’s 2in1 pioneering clutch/coupling combinations are ready-made for smooth switchover between diesel engines and electric drives. Visitors will be able to view a 2in1 featuring a flexible coupling from CENTA , showcasing the diverse combinations available to shipbuilders from both brands. Other Stromag highlights are the KMS multi-disc clutch, a compact, high torque to weight ratio unit suitable for ships of all sizes, along with the slim HPB brake for winches and hoists, which can be specified in 2- or 4-face configurations and IP67 protection. Flexible coupling expert CENTA will also display its marine range. This includes the CENTAMAX, a torsionally flexible design with in-built ventilation ideal for pump drives; the torsionally soft CENTAX, suitable for direct to engine applications with a torque range of 400 to 800,000 Nm; its CENTADISC-C series, featuring a low weight carbon shaft to expedite vessel maintenance; and the CENTALINK torsionally stiff driveshaft, with its linkages designed to easily accommodate misalignment. CENTA’s experience in flexible couplings means it is ideally placed to support the reduction of vibrations and noise from downsized diesel engines, further supporting vessel electrification and crew comfort. A highly versatile shaft locking device, Twiflex’s Turning, Locking, Braking (TLB) system will also be on stand. Available in 9 different specifications, the TLB offers any combination of a turning gear, locking device, and shaft brake paired with a hydraulic power unit (HPU) and control panel or a manual option. The multi-functionality of the TLB saves space onboard while protecting personnel during maintenance and overhauls. Jaure will also bring a range of highly engineered couplings. Its Hydraulic Shaft coupling allows simple mounting and dismounting with a high pressure oil pump, while its general purpose Lamidisc coupling is a torsionally stiff disc pack design that can compensate for misalignment. Furthermore, its MTX series of marine style gear couplings are a popular selection for propulsion, dredging, pump, deck crane, anchor and tow winch applications.
